affordances.label: Visible focus ring
affordances.evidence: Interactive controls need a visible non-motion state before hover or depth effects.
affordances.fallback: Use outline and contrast, not movement, to communicate focus.

affordances.label: Touch target padding
affordances.evidence: Mobile users need generous targets when navigation becomes dense.
affordances.fallback: Increase spacing before adding animated touch effects.

affordances.label: Form error linkage
affordances.evidence: Inputs expose hints and error states through aria-describedby and aria-errormessage.
affordances.fallback: Keep validation messages textual and adjacent to their fields.

affordances.label: Section reveal equivalence
affordances.evidence: Section reveals must preserve hierarchy when animation is disabled.
affordances.fallback: Render sections immediately with static spacing and headings.

affordances.label: Hover depth parity
affordances.evidence: Depth effects should not hide information that touch users cannot discover.
affordances.fallback: Expose the same content without hover-only reveal.

affordances.label: Loading intro skip path
affordances.evidence: Cinematic intro ideas need a skip or instant state before shipping.
affordances.fallback: Start directly at the usable app surface.

rules: Every affordance needs an equivalent static state.
Touch feedback can enhance confidence but cannot become the only signal.
Reduced-motion mode must preserve information, order, and actionability.
